questions.question: Which method can be used to set a user ID in the Braze iOS SDK after a user logs in?
questions.explanation: The correct method to change the current user ID in Braze iOS SDK is changeUser(). This is called after a user logs in to assign them a unique external_id.

questions.question: A developer wants to update a user's custom attribute 'subscription_tier' to 'premium' in their iOS Swift app. Which code snippet is correct?
questions.explanation: The correct Swift syntax is AppDelegate.braze?.user.setCustomAttribute(key:value:) to set custom attributes on the user profile.

questions.question: True or False: You can customize the appearance and behavior of in-app messages in the Braze iOS SDK.
questions.explanation: The Braze iOS SDK allows extensive customization of in-app messages through UI delegates, styling options, and custom view controllers.

questions.question: Which Braze iOS SDK framework is required to support rich push notifications with images and videos?
questions.explanation: BrazeNotificationService is the framework that must be added to your Notification Service Extension to handle rich push notifications (images, GIFs, videos).

questions.question: Which framework provides the default user interface for Content Cards in the Braze iOS SDK?
questions.explanation: BrazeUI is the framework that provides the pre-built user interface components for In-App Messages and Content Cards.

questions.question: How can a developer manually request a refresh of Content Cards in the iOS SDK?
questions.explanation: The correct method is AppDelegate.braze?.contentCards.refresh() to manually request a refresh of Content Cards from the server.

questions.question: True or False: Setting a standard attribute to nil/null in Braze will permanently delete it from the user profile.
questions.explanation: Setting a standard attribute to nil removes the current value but does not prevent it from being collected again in the future via the SDK.

questions.question: Which method is used to log a custom event with properties in the Braze iOS SDK?
questions.explanation: The correct method is AppDelegate.braze?.logCustomEvent(_:properties:) to log custom events with properties.

questions.question: To enable automatic push notification handling in the Braze iOS SDK, which configuration should be set?
questions.explanation: Setting configuration.push.automation = true enables automatic push notification handling, eliminating the need for manual delegate implementation.

questions.question: True or False: Before iOS SDK initialization, you must have a valid APNs push certificate uploaded to the Braze dashboard.
questions.explanation: To use iOS push messages, you must upload a valid APNs push certificate to the Braze dashboard. This is required for push notifications to work.

questions.question: Which framework provides location tracking and geofence support in the Braze iOS SDK?
questions.explanation: BrazeLocation is the framework that provides location analytics and geofence monitoring capabilities.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the BrazePushStory framework in the iOS SDK?
options: To provide default UI for in-app messages
To enable video content in push notifications
To support Push Stories (image carousel notifications)
questions.explanation: BrazePushStory is the framework that adds support for Push Stories, which are image carousel-style push notifications.

questions.question: True or False: In the iOS SDK, you can log a purchase event with currency and quantity information.
questions.explanation: Yes, the Braze iOS SDK supports logging purchase events with product ID, price, currency, quantity, and additional properties.

questions.question: When using the Braze iOS SDK, what happens if you call changeUser() with a new user ID?
options: The new user profile is created and the previous user data is deleted
The SDK switches to the new user profile; previously collected anonymous data is merged if fields don't already exist on the new profile
Both user profiles are merged into a single profile
The SDK returns an error if a user with that ID doesn't already exist
questions.explanation: When calling changeUser(), the SDK switches to the specified user profile and merges non-conflicting data from the anonymous profile to the identified profile.

questions.question: True or False: The Braze AppboyKit (Objective-C SDK) is still actively maintained and receives regular updates.
questions.explanation: AppboyKit (Objective-C SDK) is deprecated and no longer receives new features, bug fixes, or security updates. It has been replaced by the Braze Swift SDK.

questions.question: Which installation method allows you to integrate the Braze iOS SDK without managing dependencies through a package manager?
questions.explanation: Manual integration allows you to add the Braze SDK to your project directly without using CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager, or Carthage.

questions.question: To handle push notifications that arrive while the app is in the foreground, which UIKit method must be implemented?
questions.explanation: The userNotificationCenter(_:willPresent:withCompletionHandler:) delegate method handles notifications received while the app is in the foreground.

questions.question: True or False: You can set a custom badge count on the app icon badge using Braze in iOS.
questions.explanation: Yes, you can set a custom badge count through push notifications or manually using UNUserNotificationCenter or UIApplication properties.

questions.question: Which method allows you to log that a user has viewed a specific Content Card?
questions.explanation: The correct method is AppDelegate.braze?.contentCards.logImpression(card) to manually log Content Card impressions/views.

questions.question: True or False: Deep links from push notifications are automatically handled by the Braze iOS SDK.
questions.explanation: While the SDK supports deep links, you must implement custom logic to handle deep link URLs in your app. The SDK doesn't automatically route deep links.

questions.question: Which Braze iOS SDK method is used to add an email address alias for a user?
questions.explanation: The correct method is AppDelegate.braze?.addAlias(_:_:) to add aliases for a user, which can link multiple identifiers.

questions.question: To enable verbose logging in the Braze iOS SDK for debugging purposes, which configuration should be set?
questions.explanation: Setting configuration.logger.level = .verbose enables verbose logging for debugging the Braze SDK.

questions.question: True or False: The Braze iOS SDK automatically captures device information like device model and OS version.
questions.explanation: Yes, the Braze iOS SDK automatically captures device information such as device model, OS version, and other device data without additional setup.

questions.question: Which method is used to subscribe to in-app message events in the Braze iOS SDK?
questions.explanation: The correct method is AppDelegate.braze?.subscribeToInAppMessage() to listen and handle in-app message events.

questions.question: When should you call the Braze SDK initialization method in your iOS app?
options: In the app's main() function before any other code
After the user logs in for the first time
In the first view controller that appears
questions.explanation: The Braze SDK should be initialized in the AppDelegate's application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:) method to ensure it's ready early in the app lifecycle.

questions.question: True or False: You can set a property on a custom event before logging it to include context about the event.
questions.explanation: Yes, you can add custom event properties when logging an event to provide additional context (e.g., logCustomEvent("purchase", properties: ["amount": 99.99])).

questions.question: Which UIKit notification center method is required to handle push notification actions (buttons) on iOS?
questions.explanation: The userNotificationCenter(_:didReceive:withCompletionHandler:) method handles push notification responses, including action button taps.

questions.question: True or False: You must explicitly request permission from users before sending push notifications on iOS.
questions.explanation: Yes, iOS requires you to request user permission via UNUserNotificationCenter before sending push notifications. Users must grant permission in Settings.

questions.question: Which method allows you to manually log a purchase event with product ID, price, and currency in the iOS SDK?
questions.explanation: The correct method is AppDelegate.braze?.logPurchase(productId:price:currency:) to log purchase events in the Braze iOS SDK.

questions.question: True or False: The Braze iOS SDK continues to function and deliver messages even if you disable the SDK through configuration.
questions.explanation: If you disable the Braze SDK through configuration (e.g., for users who opt out), it will not collect data or deliver messages.
